text.description_html:
Acorn PS1YP, Hand Painted Ivory Art Cabinet Knob

Acorn made, this decorative knob will be sure to brighten up your home with its arty style by adding a unique and colorful touch to any cabinet or drawer. It features green leaves on an ivory background. Measuring 1-7/8 inches square, it is the perfect size for light interior doors such as those found on accordion closets, cabinet doors, or furniture drawers.

Features of the Ivory Art Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
